title: Pachelbel Rant from 2006 [Official High Quality Re-Post]
summary: Comedian Rob Paravonian's 'Pachelbel Rant', a comedy bit showing that the chord progression of Pachelbel's Canon underlies countless pop songs. This is a high-quality 2019 re-post of the 2006 original.
why: Recommended in threads on music copyright and chord progressions as a funny, accurate demonstration that a few chords are fundamental to music.

quote.text: If you haven't seen the 'Pachelbel Rant' yet, you should, it's an entire comedy bit based on the fact that these chords are fundamental to music
